camera.shot_scale_bias: wide-lens close-ups that bend the face outward

lens.dof: deep focus with visible edge distortion

sources: practical lamps in every corner of the set
lighting.practicals: everything is softly lit with no true black anywhere

palette.grade: heavily pushed toward green and gold

rules: densely dressed sets with objects filling every corner
objects placed in the extreme foreground
composition.movement_of_subject: small precise actions are given their own emphatic shot

sound.ambience_bias: exaggerated close object sounds, ticking, creaking, clinking

music.instrumentation: An accordion and pizzicato strings with a tack piano
music.dynamics: skipping along with playful accents on each cut

must_include: the wide lens is held close and curves the edges of the frame
the set is dressed densely with warm-coloured objects

notes: Wide lenses close to the face, gold-green grade, densely dressed frames and quick emphatic cutting.
